Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting volunteer firefighter equipment from sales and use taxation.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a sales and use tax exemption for equipmentpurchased by volunteer firefighters; adding a new section to chapter82.08 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 82.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to sales to avolunteer firefighter of equipment for use in the performance of duty.This exemption is available only if the buyer provides the seller withan exemption certificate in a form and manner prescribed by thedepartment. (2) The following definitions apply to this section and section 2of this act: (a) "Volunteer firefighter" has the meaning provided in RCW41.24.010(3). (b) "Performance of duty" has the meaning provided in RCW41.24.010(5).

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The provisions of this chapter do not apply with respect to theuse by a volunteer firefighter of equipment in the performance of duty. (2) The definitions in section 1 of this act apply to this section.
